Tempat turis, harga turis.Buat bule mungkin murah, tapi buat kita orang Indonesia? Ya jatuhnya tetep mahal 😅Nggak relate sama biaya hidup harian di Indo.Coba deh main ke district lain kayak District 3, District 5, District 10, Tan Binh, dan area luar lainnya.Nah baru tuh kerasa bedanya 😭Makan lebih murah, kopi lebih murah, belanja juga beda jauh.Bahkan supermarket jangan ke Lotte terus. column6: Thanh Ha Pottery Village (Hoi An)The price is 35,000 VND to enter the village ($1.50 USD) and explore local shops, pottery classes, and museums. They even give away a few free ceramics at special shops 🏺If you’d like to make your own piece, there are two options:1️⃣ Same day ceramic pottery is 50,000 VND ($2 USD). Note that this is decorative and you cannot drink out of it.2️⃣ If you have more time we recommend the 1-week option to allow them to fire it in the kiln and you can make a coffee mug for your favorite Vietnamese coffee ☕️ this is what we did and the cost was 200k ($8 USD)^^ We found 📍 My Linh shop to offer the kiln option. She was super sweet and helped us shape our cups too!👉 Got questions?? Leave them below!! 💬
